name: Lovable
promptStyle: Production application-building specification detailing user personas, page hierarchy, UI/UX design tokens, database schema, and acceptance criteria.
principles: Format as an end-to-end Product & Implementation Specification rather than a vague conversational prompt.
Outline pages, routing, layouts, and responsive desktop/mobile behavior explicitly.
Define concrete component hierarchy, UI state management, and design system tokens (Tailwind classes, shadcn/ui).
Specify database schema (tables, relationships, RLS policies, sample records) and external integrations.
Declare acceptance criteria and strictly define what components or files should NOT be modified or deleted.

rules.title: Application-Building Specification Format
rules.description: Structure prompt as a functional PRD with architecture, user stories, and acceptance criteria tailored for full-stack code generation.

rules.title: Define UI Components and State
rules.description: List exact components, UI states (loading, empty, error, active), and modern styling (Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, responsive breakpoints).

rules.title: Specify Boundaries & Immutable Code
rules.description: Explicitly state which directories, APIs, or architectural patterns should be preserved to prevent code regression.

contextStrategy: Organize uploaded context (existing schemas, API specs, branding) into labeled technical appendices that Lovable can translate into code.
outputGuidance: Deliver a complete, implementation-ready software specification with component breakdown, schema definition, and step-by-step build guidance.

references.title: Lovable Academy & Documentation
references.whyRelevant: Official Lovable best practices for crafting actionable full-stack application prompts and specifications.
